text.description: The target's text must contain this; with exact: true it must equal it. "/pattern/" (or "/pattern/i" to ignore case) is a regular expression.

exact.description: With text: the target's whole text must equal text (whitespace collapsed), not just contain it.

key.description: A key or chord, in Playwright key names: "Enter", "Escape", "Tab", "ArrowDown", "Control+K", "ControlOrMeta+K".

target.description: Focus this element first and press the key in it; without it, the key goes to whatever has focus.

oneOf.description: Moves the pointer over the target without clicking.
Puts keyboard focus on the target without clicking it.
Shows an email on screen: one the app sent (caught locally, matched by to/subject) or an emulated `mock`.
